description_en: Creates a version for a permission policy
description_zh: 调用CreatePolicyVersion创建权限策略版本
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager create-policy-version --policy-name OSS-Administrator --policy-document '{"Statement":[{"Action":["oss:*"],"Effect":"Allow","Resource":["acs:oss:*:*:*"]}],"Version":"1"}' --set-as-default false --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePolicyVersion

parameters.help_en:
The name of the permission policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphen (-)
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短横线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The document of the permission policy.

The document must be 1 to 6,144 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略内容。

长度为1~6144个字符
parameters.name: policy_document

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to set the policy version as the default version.

false (default)
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否设置为默认权限策略。 

false（默认值）：不设置为默认权限策略。
true：设置为默认权限策略
parameters.name: set_as_default

PolicyVersion.description_en: The information about the policy version

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the policy version was created
CreateDate.description_zh: 权限策略版本创建时间

IsDefaultVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the policy version is the default version
IsDefaultVersion.description_zh: 是否为权限策略默认版本

VersionId.description_en: The ID of the policy version
